summary: I sent the prompt and the agent ran plan.md with the subagent-driven-development skill. Each of the four tasks had an implementer, then a reviewer, before the next task started. A final whole-branch review ran, its fixes were checked by a second review, and the session ended in the finishing step, where I chose to keep the branch as-is. The session log shows 4 automatic compactions, and the controller kept its implement → review loop after each one. `npm test` passes 77/77.
reasoning: All four criteria are backed by the git repo, the npm test output and the session log. Implement and review alternated strictly for every task, including after each of the 4 compactions. The final review ran and the session ended in finishing-a-development-branch. The agent never asked about a worktree or branch: the work was already on feature/textstats, and the fixture commit 34ae458 is on that branch, not on main.

observations.description: Before starting, the agent asked a design question about the plan's tests. The plan declares PASSAGE constants that are never used and leaves out tests for listed behaviours. I answered "Proceed as you recommend." through the free-text option. The agent then added tests beyond the plan, so there are 77 tests instead of the plan's stated 32.

The agent's own final summary says one gap is still open: test/topWords.test.js:63 checks only that a TypeError is thrown, not that the message starts with "topWords:". The agent says the plan's conventions require both checks. The fix round covered only the line the final reviewer named, so the final review/fix loop didn't catch everything.

The agent noticed and pointed out the fixture's .claude/settings.json, including the autoCompactWindow setting. It also said a harness warning was triggered when a reviewer quoted that file. The test setup is visible to the agent under test.

Onboarding problems: on the trust dialog and the bypass-permissions dialog, the default selection is "No, exit". A "Newer Opus model available" prompt also appeared even though --model claude-opus-5-5 was passed; I chose No, and the header still showed Opus 5.5.

After each compaction the screen showed "Skills restored (hyperpowers:communication, hyperpowers:subagent-driven-development)". The controller also re-read the task brief, task-reviewer-prompt.md and implementer-prompt.md from the plan's cache directory. That re-reading may be what kept the loop working after compaction.
The agent noted that the Codex CLI isn't installed, so none of its review checks ran, and it recorded each skip in an ungated ledger.
The agent noticed that a fix commit's trailer credited Sonnet instead of Opus 5.5, and amended that commit message on its own.

criteria.criterion: All four functions are exported from src/textstats.js, each has its own test file, they are committed, and npm test passes
criteria.evidence: src/textstats.js:141 `module.exports = { wordCount, sentenceCount, topWords, readingTimeMinutes };`. The test/ folder has wordCount, sentenceCount, topWords and readingTimeMinutes .test.js files. Commits are ba68b60, a033b0d, 4e4f2a9, 6d130c2 and 980ec4f, and `git status --short` was empty. `npm test` output: `ℹ tests 77 ℹ pass 77 ℹ fail 0`.

criteria.criterion: Each task is reviewed before the next task starts
criteria.evidence: Agent dispatches in order, from jq on session log dc05f608...jsonl: 20:17:24 Implement Task 1 → 20:18:47 Review Task 1 → 20:19:32 Implement Task 2 → 20:20:38 Review Task 2 → 20:21:40 Implement Task 3 → 20:22:59 Review Task 3 → 20:23:40 Implement Task 4 → 20:25:26 Review Task 4. This order held across compact_boundary events at 20:18:03, 20:21:06, 20:24:47 and 20:28:28.

criteria.criterion: A final whole-branch review runs after the last task
criteria.evidence: Log: 20:26:06 `Agent Final whole-branch review`, then 20:27:30 `Apply final-review test fixes` and 20:28:58 `Re-review final fix wave`. On screen: "The final whole-branch review found three minor test gaps. They're fixed in 980ec4f, and a second review confirmed the fix."

criteria.criterion: The session ends in the finishing step
criteria.evidence: Log: 20:29:14 `Skill hyperpowers:finishing-a-development-branch`. The screen offered options 1 Merge / 2 Push+PR / 3 Keep the branch as-is. I replied "Keep the branch as-is" and the agent answered: "I've left feature/textstats as it is, ending at 980ec4f... Nothing was merged, pushed, or deleted."
